name: FIB-SEM Analysis Detail
abstract: Detail block for FIB-SEM hasPart items. Discriminates on ada:componentType, carries analysis-level required properties and an @id reference to a registered semFibsemTAPP definition, and per-dataset schema:additionalProperty entries constrained via $refs to the parameterValues registry plus a catch-all. Generated by tools/build_tapp.py.

examples.title: detail example Garvie2008
examples.content: detail instance derived from Garvie et al. 2008 | Tagish Lake (C2) nanoglobules | TEM Sample Preparation (FIB, FEI Nova 200 NanoLab).

examples.title: detail example Liu2017
examples.content: detail instance derived from Liu et al. 2017 | High-rank coal (Qinshui basin) | 3D Tomography (Carl Zeiss Crossbeam 540).

examples.title: detail example Zhou2017
examples.content: detail instance derived from Zhou et al. 2017 | Coal (SC + HBC, Junggar Basin) | 3D Tomography (FEI Helios NanoLab 650).

examples.title: detail example Zega2025
examples.content: detail instance derived from Zega et al. 2025 | Bennu asteroid particles (OSIRIS-REx) | TEM Sample Preparation (Helios G3, U Arizona).

examples.title: detail example Zega2025-2
examples.content: detail instance derived from Zega et al. 2025 | Bennu asteroid particles (OSIRIS-REx) | TEM Sample Preparation (Helios G4 UX, UC Berkeley).

examples.title: detail example Zega2025-3
examples.content: detail instance derived from Zega et al. 2025 | Bennu asteroid particles (OSIRIS-REx) | TEM Sample Preparation (Quanta3D600, NASA JSC).

                  or milliseconds.

                    const: ada:parameter/semFibsemTAPP/dwellTimePerPixel

                - '@type'

                - schema:name
                - schema:value
                - schema:unitText
